paracetamol.description: Primary UV absorption band at 243 nm due to π → π* aromatic amide transition.

caffeine.description: Primary UV absorption band at 273 nm due to purine imidazole ring π → π* transition.

aspirin.description: Absorption maximum at 276 nm (E2 band) and high-energy band at 230 nm.

ibuprofen.description: Isobutylphenyl propionic acid exhibiting weak aromatic fine structure bands at 264 nm and 273 nm.

salicylic_acid.description: Intense absorption band at 303 nm due to intramolecular hydrogen bonding in ortho-hydroxybenzoic acid.

benzoic_acid.description: Aromatic carboxylic acid exhibiting benzenoid absorption at 228 nm and secondary band at 272 nm.
